jobs.title: Python Full Stack Developer Intern
jobs.description:
**Job Summary**

We are seeking an enthusiastic and motivated **Full\-Stack Python Developer** to join our fast\-paced development team. This entry\-level role is perfect for a fresher with a **strong foundational understanding** of Python, web frameworks (like Django or Flask), and front\-end technologies. You will work on both the client\-side and server\-side of our web applications, contributing to all phases of the software development lifecycle. This is an excellent opportunity to grow your skills in a mentorship\-driven environment and build scalable, efficient, and well\-documented code.

**Key Responsibilities**

· **Development:** Write clean, scalable, and testable code for both the front\-end and back\-end components of web applications using Python and associated frameworks.

· **Front\-End Focus:** Implement user interface (UI) and user experience (UX) designs using HTML, CSS, and JavaScript to ensure a responsive and visually appealing user experience.

· **Back\-End Logic:** Develop and maintain server\-side application logic, integrating it with front\-end services and third\-party APIs.

· **Database Management:** Assist in designing and managing database schemas (SQL/NoSQL) and writing efficient queries to interact with the data layer.

· **Collaboration:** Actively participate in code reviews, daily stand\-ups, and sprint planning meetings, providing constructive feedback and contributing to team goals.

· **Testing \& Debugging:** Identify, troubleshoot, and resolve bugs and performance issues across the entire application stack.

· **Documentation:** Create and maintain technical documentation for new features, APIs, and system architecture.

**Required Skills \& Qualifications**

· **Education:** Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Design, Information Technology, or a related technical field (or equivalent practical experience/coding bootcamp completion).

· **Core Languages:** Strong proficiency in **HTML5, CSS3, and modern JavaScript (ES6\+).**

· **Framework/Library Basics:** Foundational knowledge of at least one modern front\-end library/framework (e.g., **React, Vue, or Angular**).

· **Styling:** Familiarity with CSS preprocessors (e.g., Sass, Less) or CSS frameworks (e.g., Bootstrap, Tailwind CSS).

· **Design Tools:** Exposure to design hand\-off tools like **Figma, Sketch, or Adobe XD**.

· **Version Control:** Basic working knowledge of **Git** for collaborative development.

Pay: ₹2,500\.00 \- ₹8,000\.00 per month

Work Location: In person

jobs.title: Full Stack Developer Intern
jobs.description:
**Tech Stack**

* **Frontend:** React.js (Hooks, Context API)
* **Backend:** Node.js, Express.js, REST APIs
* **Database:** PostgreSQL
* **DevOps \& Cloud:** Docker, AWS

**Responsibilities**

* Collaborate with the product and engineering team to build and improve full\-stack features.
* Develop responsive frontend components using React.js.
* Build and maintain backend APIs using Node.js and Express.js.
* Work with PostgreSQL databases for application development.
* Debug issues, optimize application performance, and improve code quality.
* Participate in code reviews and team discussions.
* Take ownership of assigned tasks and deliver them within deadlines.
* Learn new technologies and contribute to product development in a fast\-paced startup environment.

**Requirements**

* Good understanding of **React.js** and **Node.js**.
* Familiarity with JavaScript (ES6\+), HTML, and CSS.
* Basic understanding of REST APIs and backend development.
* Knowledge of PostgreSQL or any relational database.
* Familiarity with Git and version control.
* Strong analytical and problem\-solving skills.
* Self\-motivated, eager to learn, and comfortable working independently.
* Good communication and collaboration skills.

**Preferred Skills (Nice to Have)**

* Experience with Express.js.
* Basic knowledge of Docker and AWS.
* Understanding of authentication (JWT/OAuth).
* Personal projects, internships, or GitHub contributions.

**Selection Process**

* Resume screening
* Task\-based practical assessment
* Technical interview

Selected candidates will undergo a **probation period** during the internship, during which performance, consistency, and commitment will be evaluated before final confirmation.

**What You'll Gain**

* Opportunity to work on a live production product.
* Exposure to real\-world startup development and product building.
* End\-to\-end full\-stack development experience.
* Mentorship from experienced developers.
* Certificate of Internship upon successful completion.
* Potential opportunity for a Pre\-Placement Offer (PPO) based on performance.

Pay: ₹5,000\.00 \- ₹10,000\.00 per month

Benefits:

* Flexible schedule
* Work from home

Work Location: Remote

jobs.title: Full Stack Web Developer Intern
jobs.description:
We are looking for a skilled and responsible **Full\-Stack Web Developer** who can independently handle both **Frontend and Backend Development**. The candidate should have strong practical experience in developing, maintaining and improving websites and web applications.

Key Responsibilities

* Develop and maintain responsive, fast and user\-friendly websites.
* Handle complete **Frontend \+ Backend Development**.
* Build modern and responsive user interfaces.
* Develop and manage backend functionality and databases.
* Create and integrate REST APIs and third\-party APIs.
* Work on websites, admin panels, dashboards and internal web applications.
* Troubleshoot bugs and resolve technical issues.
* Improve website speed, performance and security.
* Manage databases and ensure proper data handling.
* Write clean, structured and reusable code.
* Use Git/GitHub for source code management.
* Deploy and maintain web applications.
* Understand business requirements and convert them into functional web solutions.
* Complete assigned tasks and projects within deadlines.

Required Technical Skills

**Frontend:** React.js, JavaScript, HTML5, CSS3  
**Backend:** Node.js, Express.js  
**Database:** MySQL and/or MongoDB  
**Additional Skills:** REST APIs, API Integration, Git/GitHub, Debugging \& Troubleshooting

Educational Qualification

**BCA / MCA / B.Tech / B.E. / Computer Science / IT or Equivalent Qualification**

**Note:** Practical skills, coding knowledge and real project experience will be given priority over educational qualification.

Candidate Requirements

* **Only candidates currently residing in Faridabad are eligible to apply.**
* **Candidates from outside Faridabad will not be considered.**
* 0–2 years of practical experience in Web Development.
* Strong knowledge of both Frontend and Backend Development.
* Must have worked on live websites or web applications.
* Good problem\-solving and debugging skills.
* Ability to handle assigned development tasks independently.
* Strong understanding of databases and API integration.
* Must be able to meet project deadlines.
* Candidates may be required to complete a practical coding/technical assessment during the interview process.

Pay: ₹15,000\.00 \- ₹20,000\.00 per month

Benefits:

* Flexible schedule
* Leave encashment
* Life insurance
* Paid time off

Work Location: In person
